name: CanBePromoted
comment: next title t = title+1: land >= DS:57f4[t], taler >= DS:581c[t], pop >= DS:5844[t], palace_parts >= DS:586f[t], cathedral_parts >= DS:5879[t], ArmyStrength >= DS:58bc[t], happiness >= DS:587e[t]

name: PromotionCheck
comment: End of turn: if CanBePromoted: lifetime+1, title+1, fame+10, promotion dialog; title 10 -> Victory; first player to become Koenig gets a bonus (FIRSTKINGDLG)

name: RevolutionCheck
comment: End of turn: happiness < 0.3 -> uprising; Random(round(happiness*10)) = 0 -> exile (skip a year, title-1, fame-50, lifetime-2), else crushed (fame-10, lifetime-1)

name: GrainShortageWarning
comment: End of turn: ZUWENIGKORNDLG if less grain than needed is distributed; offers the grain dialog

name: LandLossCheck
comment: End of turn: BuildingsLostForLand

name: SkipTurnCheck
comment: End of turn: AUSSETZDLG, sets skip_turn

name: ShowStartTurnDialog
comment: Start of turn: STARTTURNDLG / STARTTURNFEMDLG; false ends the game

name: WitchChoosesSpell
comment: Game start (year 0): HEXENDLG, the witch offers the spells

name: GrantFirstHero
comment: Game start: HELDDLG, the first hero

name: RulerFallsIll
comment: KRANKDLG when lifetime < 1

name: SabotageEnd
comment: SABOTAGEENDEDLG: a sabotage operation ends

name: DiplomacyTurnStart_q
comment: Turn start: treaties (PEACEENDDLG: peace treaty expired), messages

name: ArmyTurnStart_q
comment: Turn start when title > 1 or Terror: army processing (vampires multiply)

name: YearSummary_q
comment: Last step of PlayerTurnStart: yearly summary text

name: IsFirstKing_q
comment: PromotionCheck: decides the first-king bonus

name: ArmyStrength
comment: Strength of the army (mode 1 used for promotion); see military

name: PromotionLand
comment: longint[11] land needed for title t

name: PromotionTaler
comment: longint[11] taler needed

name: PromotionPopulation
comment: longint[11] population needed

name: PromotionPalaceParts
comment: byte[11]

name: PromotionCathedralParts
comment: byte[11]

name: PromotionHappiness
comment: Real48[11]

name: PromotionArmyStrength
comment: longint[11]
